claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings provide three validated complementary modes at maximum evaluated scale (24yr/158k): (1) citation heritage recovery AUC 0.767-0.770 > 0.75, (2) section cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings but not reasoning, (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4 but remaining below TF-IDF baseline on jurist preference. No single representation dominates all metrics. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES pending corpus completion.
evidence_summary: All 17 evidence_refs in legal-distance.json verified against raw evaluation outputs. Citation heritage: center_projected AUC 0.818 (21yr/100 pairs), 0.792 (22yr/344 pairs), 0.767 (24yr/730 pairs) — all >0.75 threshold. Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282>0.2 PASS, Dispositiv=0.150>0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen=0.094<0.1 FAIL. Linear hybrids: 22yr weight sweep PASS both adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4 (JP 0.61-0.67, LangDom 0.65-0.75) but below TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79). Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (3yr JP 0.39-0.42, 15yr 0.288, 19yr 0.37, 20yr 0.05, 22yr 0.43, 165k 0.39-0.42). Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus FAILS 7-8/14 benchmarks (AUC~0.5 citation heritage, kNN 0.26-0.39). v18 coarse hierarchy FAIL (purity 0.65<0.7). True OOS JP ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping missing, 2024-2026 parquet missing (15,536 decisions), section extraction not at 174k scale. 2022-2023 embeddings EXIST and PASS citation heritage (AUC>0.75) despite progress.json 'failed' flag. Negative results honestly represented as first-class evidence. No leakage, weak baselines, benchmark gaming, or boilerplate confounding detected.
